title: Celestia Namespace
description: A 29-byte namespace identifier. First byte is the namespace version; remaining 28 bytes are the namespace ID. Namespaces partition Celestia blockspace so each rollup or application can read only the data relevant to it via Namespaced Merkle Trees (NMT).

version.description: Namespace version byte (0 = primary user namespace).

raw.description: Full 29-byte namespace (version || id) encoded in hex or base64.
